positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
https://reactide.github.io/reactide-website/- The first React dedicated IDE with over 10K stars on GitHub.
• Led the launch and implemented functionality for Reactide, a native desktop IDE application that includes an automated Webpack configuration and an in-app browser simulator with hot module reloading for developers to get straight to developing React applications without the setup.
• Leveraged Redux’s Flux design pattern to manage a central data store with a unidirectional flow across all React components to prevent anti-patterns such as prop drilling, ensuring predictability of state changes with improved scalability, semantics and debugging process.
• Harnessed Electron’s Node runtime with Chromium’s view engine to provide a native IDE for Mac, Windows and Linux, cultivating better performance with multi-processing power and non thread-blocking features that allow access to the file system and in-app browser simulator.
• Pinpointed React components by using Flow parser to create a recursive abstract syntax tree lookup function for each of the user’s files and construct an object that represents the parent-child relationship of the components for a proper visualization of the component hierarchy.
• Incorporated Enzyme, Mocha, Sinon and Spectron automated testing frameworks following the TDD red, green, refactor approach for rapid, for parallelized test suites, and integration/unit-test coverage monitoring to increase codebase maintainability and future implementations.
• Implemented Next.js for the landing page to utilize Server-side Rendering and optimize SEO due to prioritizing rendering of static files on the server which enables web scrapers to catch all the necessary keywords that would normally be missed during client-side rendering.
• Configured Webpack for hot module reloading, asset bundling and transpilation to simulate live web server for reduced development time.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Owned and maintained the tagger feature in the React ecosystem for DocuSign's flagship electronic agreements product.  
• Supported and implemented backend features using Node.js and Postgres across all full-stack applications.  
• Led the interviewing, hiring, and mentoring of four engineers, focusing on both technical and non-technical skills.  
• Maintained the internal design system with Material UI to ensure consistent UI/UX across the organization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Owned and maintained the Buyer and Seller UI for flagship application utilizing React ecosphere while collaborating with Product and Design. 
• Managed offshore contracting team of six engineers located in Serbia by unblocking and providing technical leadership and design efforts.
• Maintained internal design system that leveraged Material UI to ensure consistent styling and design across the entire organization’s UI/UX.
• Utilized Docker with microservices to improve ROI by allowing multiple clients to continuously integrate and deploy with version control.
• Oncall support for the entire fleet of LiveRamp applications that required weekly rotations, independent and cross-team communication.
positions.insights: Skills: Web Development · Web Design · JavaScript · System design · React.js

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Upgraded React in Student Loan Refinance flagship application from v0.13 to v17 that included over 300 highly customized components.
• Launched Bundled Savings application that utilized Java Spring, Postgres, Docker, React, Redux, Typescript and Webpack as a stack.
• Refactored and migrated heavily customized JOI validation and Reflux state management logic that included six years of technical debt.
• Ensured the maintenance of the entire front-end stack across the organization being the Subject Matter Expert and leading design meetings. 
• Developed the front-end of Employer Contribution, a platform that allows employers to contribute to their employees student loans.
• Designed the front-end architecture of Employer Contribution, a greenfield product, in a way that would boilerplate a lot of work for Student Loan React upgrade.
• Supported and implemented features utilizing Ruby on Rails and Postgres for the backend across five different full stack applications.
• Utilized Docker with microservices to improve ROI by allowing multiple clients to continuously integrate and deploy with version control.
• Supported AWS to GCP migration by understanding the difference in function and environment between both Cloud providers.

positions.title: Two-Auth
positions.description:
NPM library that simplifies two-factor SMS authentication
• Improved authentication security and simplified the implementation process by wrapping Twilio’s SMS authentication in an NPM package allowing users to implement SMS authentication with a single method from the library to add a second factor in the authentication process.
• Implemented support for SQL and NoSQL databases by utilizing Postgres and MongoDB in order to cater to a wide variety of end-users.
• Incorporated Mocha, Chai and Jest testing frameworks to simplify the test-driven development process with more control over unit and integration testing, which reduces the time spent on any rework while allowing future developers to also spend less time debugging.

positions.title: Positalk
positions.description:
Social media platform for positive quotes
• Implemented Redux as state management to simplify the React debugging process with further modularity and access to Redux DevTools.
• Used Redux-Thunk for asynchronous data flow in the Redux store to make fetch requests to a RESTful API and obtain the relevant data.
• Configured Webpack to bundle the application for gaining access to a proxy server and enabling hot module reloading capabilities.

positions.title: Interactive Developer Roadmap
positions.description:
Platform for sharing dev resources
• Implemented React Hooks to simplify the use of state by allowing components the ability to access state without the need of prop drilling.
• Utilized a ElephantSQL’s database management as a hosted server architect to automate the relationship between server and database. 
• Used Webpack to create a proxy server to run simultaneous servers and allow subsequent communication between client and server.
• Automated authentication by implementing OAuth and utilizing GitHub’s security process while allowing users easier access to the platform.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Implemented React as a Javascript framework to reuse components and refactor web applications by improving the hierarchy and structure for client's code base
•	Improved UI/UX for web pages by using the DOM API and rendering with HTML, CSS and Javascript to practice optimal semantic patterns such as accessibility for users and proper tag handling to avoid anti-patterns and immensely improve modularity
